nodes.label: Backtest Runner
nodes.rationale: Replays the full production orchestrator day-by-day against historical OHLC, entirely offline (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is popped so narrators fall back to templates); default 5-trading-day decision cadence because slow signals (50/200 SMA, 14-day RSI) gain only noise from daily firing. Honest limitations are documented: no historical fundamentals, mostly empty macro, simplified execution (stop assumed to hit first when a bar contains both stop and target), single shared cash pool with no FX.

nodes.label: Scenario Regression Set
nodes.rationale: 15 frozen hand-labeled (context, expected_signal) JSON pairs run through the full pipeline in CI; offline and LLM-free so CI is free and reproducible, and any rule/prompt/threshold change that drifts a labeled signal fails the build immediately with a pointed diagnostic. Covers all five signal classes, public-domain override examples (OVR-O1 fraud, OVR-O2 guidance withdrawal, OVR-O3 dividend cut), and a partial-data graceful-degradation case.

nodes.label: PortfolioSimulator
nodes.rationale: Simulates stops, targets, and multi-ticker positions; conservatively assumes the stop hit first when a single bar touches both stop and target, and does not model slippage or partial fills.

nodes.label: HistoricalContextBuilder
nodes.rationale: Synthesises per-day context from cached OHLC only (indicators, relative strength, VIX, beta); fields not derivable from price are left absent because the rule evaluator already skips missing-data rules and treats them as neutral 50, so backtests degrade gracefully on incomplete history. Extension point for historical fundamentals/FRED macro providers.

nodes.label: NoopBuilder
nodes.rationale: Replaces ContextBuilder during backtests so no live API calls happen inside the loop; context is injected via arun(..., context_overrides=...).

nodes.label: Self-Contained HTML Backtest Report (eval/reports.py)
nodes.rationale: Output is a single HTML file with inline CSS and SVG charts, no JS dependencies, so it opens in any browser; contains summary cards, equity curve vs buy-and-hold benchmarks, trades table, and full decision log.
